# One case of place_job, on Maya's rooftop-garden app.
case	The same busy runners, but a batch's job keeps the kept runner and stays
places	order=own,tenki,github wait=10 connected=tenki usual=6
job	linux	batch	self-hosted,linux,pr
keep	on
queued	5
gone	no
now	1793000000
runner	online	true	self-hosted,linux,pr
runner	online	true	self-hosted,linux,pr
runner	online	false	self-hosted,linux
expect	own	self-hosted,linux	no	-	-
words	This ran on your machines.
